business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

Double Taxation Arrangement between the Mainland of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for the Avoidance of Double Taxation on Enterprises and Individuals

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Money Laundering (as revised, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (SAMR and PBOC Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); PRC Company Law (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Market Entity Registration Administrative Regulations (effective 1 March 2022); Hong Kong Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615); Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) Part 7A significant controllers register; HKMA AML/CFT Guideline.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of Hong Kong Holding Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy by company secretary, notarized by Hong Kong Notary Public, then Apostille by Hong Kong High Court Registry under the Hague Apostille Convention (HCCH 1961). Apostille path is final because Hong Kong is a Contracting State; do not add Chinese consular legalization. Documents from non-Contracting States must instead use consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate; the two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of Hong Kong Holding Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued by Companies Registry, notarized by Hong Kong Notary Public, then Apostille by Hong Kong High Court Registry. Do not chain consular legalization after apostille. For non-Apostille states, use consular legalization route exclusively.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney Authorizing WFOE Formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Holding Company Board of Directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Board secretary certifies true copy; Hong Kong Notary Public notarizes; Hong Kong High Court Registry issues Apostille. If the resolution is executed outside Hong Kong or outside the Apostille Convention, the foreign notarial act must be legalized by consular officials; never use both Apostille and Consular Legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the WFOE (Zinc Alloy Die-Casting Model Enterprise)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: WFOE founding shareholder and legal counsel under PRC Company Law
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signature page of HK shareholder must be notarized and apostilled in Hong Kong under the Hague Convention before submission to SAMR. If the shareholder is in a non-Apostille jurisdiction, execute a separate notarized signature and consular legalization. No sequential Apostille-plus-legalization. The substantive Chinese-language version is filed with SAMR, with English version certified for translation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from Hong Kong Licensed Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued on bank letterhead, signed by branch manager, certified as true by bank, notarized by Hong Kong Notary Public, then Apostille by Hong Kong High Court Registry. If the bank is based in a non-Apostille state, consular legalization by Chinese consulate replaces Apostille; never both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of No Criminal Conviction for Directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Police certificate notarized by Notary Public and Apostilled by Hong Kong High Court Registry. For UBOs or directors from non-Apostille countries, the certificate must be legalized by Chinese consulate; the two routes are alternatives, not cumulative.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All beneficial owners, directors, signatories, and ultimate parents must be screened before filing against (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) List; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) China MOFCOM and MPS sanctions and unreliable entities list; and (v) HM Treasury consolidated list. Screening must include look-through of every ownership layer above 25%, political exposure from government and gazette sources, sanctions matches, adverse media, insolvency, and source-of-wealth red flags. Any PEP or sanctions hit requires enhanced due diligence, senior partner written clearance, and a suspicious transaction report if funds are from unknown sources.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration System through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform for the mainland WFOE; Hong Kong Companies Registry e-Registry Cybersearch for the HK holding entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE legal name must be in simplified Chinese characters. The statutory four-tier structure is administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or operation characteristics plus legal form (limited company). The English name is a translation only and must phonetically correspond in pinyin without causing misleading similarity. The Hong Kong holding company must have an approved English name and, if a Chinese name is used, a Chinese name registered with the Hong Kong Companies Registry; transliteration must not create conflict.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 30 days and are not statutory extendable; a fresh application must be filed if the enterprise is not registered in time. If the name is rejected, request a written rejection stating the conflicting name, same-industry comparison, or prohibited token. Within 60 days of receipt, file an administrative reconsideration with the municipal SAMR or the next-higher market regulation authority, attaching the original rejection notice, proposed simplified Chinese name, pinyin transliteration, ISIC 3240 business scope, and evidence that the proposed distinctive token is not identical or deceptively similar. The reconsideration body must issue a decision within 60 days. If the decision denies the appeal, administrative litigation may be commenced in the competent people's court within 15 days after receipt of the reconsideration decision; in parallel, reserve an alternative distinctive name to avoid losing the formation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an ISIC 3240 zinc-alloy die-casting and tampo-printing WFOE, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible. SAMR, tax bureaus, and banks will reject a non-physical address because the enterprise must maintain a factory, warehouse, production machinery, and employee presence. The business license must state the actual industrial premises, and the bank account opening requires on-site inspection. A separate sales-representative office may be virtual, but the registered office must be the physical leasehold. Include the real estate certificate or lease with notarized chop, utility invoices, and fire safety documents.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Risk is high (approximately 75%) within the first 12 months for an active manufacturing WFOE. Inspection checklist: 1) business license displayed on premises; 2) physical factory sign; 3) die-casting machines and production line; 4) raw material inventory (zinc alloy, paints, tampo pads); 5) payroll and attendance records; 6) tax invoices and accounting books; 7) fire extinguishers and emergency exits; 8) environmental discharge permits; 9) lease agreement; 10) water and electricity bills matching use. Municipal SAMR, tax, fire, and environmental authorities may conduct unannounced daytime inspections.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), particularly Articles 23-50 on establishment, articles of association, board of directors and legal representative, and Article 47 on the five-year statutory contribution period; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 4, 6 and 13; Regulation on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law (State Council Decree No. 723); and the Measures for the Registration of Foreign-Invested Companies issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the Enterprise Registration and Foreign Investment Registration Department of the local Market Supervision Administration with jurisdiction over the registered office of the WFOE.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Portal and the National Foreign Investment Integrated Service Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under the PRC Foreign Investment Law and the current Company Law, there is no statutory minimum registered capital for a general WFOE and no government escrow or blocked-account requirement solely for incorporation. However, shareholders must pay subscribed registered capital in full within five years from establishment unless another law or regulation prescribes a shorter period or a special licensing regime imposes a minimum paid-up capital. Contributions must be made into a bank capital-contribution account opened after incorporation and may not be reduced or returned except through lawful capital reduction proceedings.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN-WFOE-LTD (the Company), a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company to be established under the laws of the People's Republic of China. RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of all directors, as follows: 1. INCORPORATION AND SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. That the Company be incorporated with the name, business scope and articles of association submitted to the State Administration for Market Regulation. That the authorized registered capital of the Company be [CURRENCY AND AMOUNT], divided into [NUMBER] ordinary shares of par value [VALUE] each. That the sole shareholder, HK-HOLDING-LIMITED, hereby subscribes for all such issued shares on the terms set forth in the articles of association. That the directors are authorized to open a capital contribution account, to call up contributions, and to receive and invest such contributed capital in accordance with the Company Law, the Foreign Investment Law and the articles of association. That no contribution shall be repaid, distributed or released to the shareholder except through lawful reduction of capital or liquidation. 2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE. That the registered office of the Company be established at [FULL ADDRESS OF PRC LEASED OR OWNED PREMISES], and that the directors and officers be authorized to execute and deliver the lease, property ownership certificate, occupancy certificate, fire safety acceptance documentation and any other instrument necessary to maintain the registered office and to amend the same from time to time. 3. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. That [NAME OF BANK], [BRANCH AND ADDRESS], be and is hereby designated as the principal settlement bank for the Company. That any two of the Chairman, the legal representative and the General Manager, acting jointly, be authorized to open, operate, close and manage bank accounts, to execute banking facility documents, to sign cheques and electronic payment instructions, and to give indemnities, all subject to the Company's internal control and segregation of duties. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. That [NAME] be appointed as Chairperson and legal representative; [NAME] be appointed as Executive Director or General Manager; [NAME] be appointed as Supervisor; and [NAME] be appointed as General Manager, each with duties, powers and compensation as specified in the articles of association and in compliance with the Company Law. 5. CORPORATE SEALS AND REGISTRATION FILINGS. That the General Manager be authorized to arrange the engraving of the company seal, financial seal, contract seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal after obtaining the relevant Public Security Bureau registration, and to make all filings with SAMR, the tax authority, the foreign exchange authority, social insurance agency, housing fund authority and any other competent authority for the lawful establishment and operation of the Company. 6. AUTHORIZATION OF AGENTS. That the directors may engage notaries, lawyers, accountants and company-formation agents to prepare, sign and submit applications, to respond to regulatory queries, and to pay prescribed fees. 7. EFFECTIVENESS. That these resolutions take effect immediately upon adoption and may be executed in counterparts; they remain effective until amended or revoked by a subsequent valid resolution of the board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-approval of Company Name and Business Scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation through the local Market Supervision Administration one-stop online enterprise name and business scope pre-registration portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three to five proposed Chinese company names, specify the exact business scope covering zinc alloy die-casting, tampo printing, assembly and sale of collectible scale automotive replicas, and verify that no name conflict exists and that the scope does not touch the Foreign Investment Negative List. The promoter shall confirm the corresponding national industry classification code and state expressly that products are collectible scale models rather than children's toys if the end-market designation is to be used for CCC exemption analysis. After approval, obtain the name-approval notice and the accepted business scope language to be used in the formal registration application.
required_dossiers: Completed name pre-approval application form
Three to five proposed Chinese company names
Shareholder identity or business registration certificate of the Hong Kong parent
Proposed business scope statement with product description
Power of attorney appointing the local formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict or confusion, immediately re-file with additional distinctive name combinations and with a written explanation of the business goods and marks. If the business scope is queried due to negative-list or licensing concerns, narrow the wording to die-cast metal model craft production, remove any prohibited service element, and obtain an official written scope determination from the local Market Supervision Administration before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Authentication of Hong Kong Shareholder Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Hong Kong notary public and China Legal Service Hong Kong, the Ministry of Justice-authorized legal service body for authentication of Hong Kong corporate documents for use in mainland China.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain recent official extracts from the Hong Kong Companies Registry and Business Registration Office including the certificate of incorporation, current business registration certificate and register of directors and shareholders. Have these documents notarized by a Hong Kong notary public and then verified by China Legal Service Hong Kong through the legalized authentication process. Arrange for a licensed translation service to translate the authenticated documents into Chinese if required by the receiving local Market Supervision Administration. Ensure that the authentication certificate has a validity period sufficient to remain current through the SAMR filing date.
required_dossiers: Hong Kong Certificate of Incorporation
Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate and current Business Registration Branch Certificate
Copy of company particulars and directors/members list from Companies Registry
Passport or Hong Kong identity card of the authorised shareholder representative
Notarized certificate and China Legal Service Hong Kong authentication endorsement
Certified Chinese translation of the notarized corporate document package
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the authentication is challenged because the notary certificate is outdated or the translation is insufficient, commission a supplementary notarization and authentication with corrected wording and resubmit the complete package to SAMR. In case of rejection for missing signatures, have the Hong Kong director countersign under the notary and repeat the legalization cycle before the second filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration with jurisdiction over the registered office, through the National Enterprise Registration Portal and the National Foreign Investment Integrated Service Platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company Establishment Registration Application, together with the notarized and authenticated Hong Kong shareholder documents, the approved business scope, the signed articles of association, lease contract and property ownership certificate for the registered office, and the appointment instruments for director, supervisor, legal representative and general manager. Verify that the registered capital, contribution schedule and business scope conform to the Foreign Investment Law and the Company Law and that the foreign investment information report is automatically transmitted or manually lodged. After review, collect the business license bearing the Unified Social Credit Code and the establishment registration notice.
required_dossiers: Signed Application for Establishment Registration of Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company
Two original and two electronic copies of the articles of association
Notarized and authenticated Hong Kong parent company documents
Certified Chinese translation of the Hong Kong corporate documents
Lease contract and property ownership certificate or building-use certificate for the registered office
Identity certificates of director, supervisor, legal representative and general manager
Appointment letters and resignation or non-concurrent letters
Power of attorney and identity of the formation agent
Foreign investment information report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction or suspension notice, cure the stated omissions within fifteen working days by filing supplementary signatures, revised articles of association, updated property documents or revised capital contribution schedules. If the registration is rejected on substantive legal grounds, file a renewed application with corrected structure and, where necessary, apply for administrative reconsideration before the municipal SAMR or initiate judicial review before the competent people's court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Seals, Tax, Foreign Exchange, Labor and Capital Contribution Set-up
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Public Security Bureau for seal engraving registration; State Taxation Administration local tax office; State Administration of Foreign Exchange local branch and the appointed commercial bank; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; and local housing fund management center.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the business license, engage a Public Security Bureau-approved engraving company to create the company seal, financial seal, contract seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal, and record the seal impressions with the Public Security Bureau. Then complete tax registration, social insurance and housing fund registration using the Unified Social Credit Code. Open the company basic bank account and capital contribution account, register foreign exchange information with SAFE through the bank, and report any foreign debt or cross-border remittance structure. Contribute the subscribed capital within the legal and contractual timeframe and submit the required capital contribution information. If the company will export the scale models, also complete customs registration and, if applicable, export tax rebate filing.
required_dossiers: Original business license and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Seal engraving authorization letter and identity certificate of legal representative
Seal registration form from Public Security Bureau-approved engraving company
Tax registration forms and banking account opening permit
Foreign exchange establishment registration form and capital verification if requested
Social insurance and housing fund registration forms
Employment contracts and labor contract registration reporting forms
Customs registration application and business license copies if importing raw aluminium/zinc alloy or exporting finished models
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax, foreign exchange or social insurance filings are rejected or late, immediately pay the minimal administrative late fee, submit all outstanding declarations through the respective online platforms, and apply for an extension or rectification where the law permits. For seal-registration issues, destroy the non-registered seal under Public Security supervision and re-engrave through an approved vendor. For capital contribution recall or foreign exchange registration errors, contact the designated bank and SAFE to file a post-event correction within the permitted cure period to avoid penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation and the local Market Supervision Administration for industrial product quality and production permits; Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental permits; Ministry of Emergency Management and the local Emergency Management Bureau for work safety and fire protection acceptance; with sectoral oversight by the local Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology for manufacturing activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: The company must hold the business license, a validated construction project environmental protection acceptance, a Pollutant Discharge Permit where discharge occurs, fire protection design review and fire acceptance certification, and, if the die-cast scale automotive model is legally classified as a toy intended for or suitable for children under 14, the China Compulsory Certification certificate for toy products; if the product is marketed strictly as an adult collectible, a detailed conformity and age-warning assessment must be retained to support the CCC exemption.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: A full Environmental Impact Report is likely required for a production facility involving zinc alloy melting, die-casting, painting, tampo printing and waste handling because such activities constitute significant pollutant-discharge construction projects under the Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects. A less burdensome Environmental Impact Report Form or Environmental Registration may apply only if the facility conducts no melting, casting, painting or other listed hazardous process and is limited to assembly and packaging; the final classification tier must be confirmed in writing by the local Ecology and Environment Bureau before construction and equipment installation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to surface water must meet the integrated first-class standards of GB 8978-1996, including COD no greater than 100 mg/L, BOD5 no greater than 30 mg/L, suspended solids no greater than 70 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen no greater than 15 mg/L and pH 6-9; if discharging into a municipal sewage network with an applicable combined acceptance, discharge must also satisfy the sewer standards of CJ 343-2010. Paint stripping, tampo printing and surface coating operations must control volatile organic compounds according to GB 37822-2019, with fugitive NMHC within the workshop not exceeding 30 mg/m3 and process exhaust NMHC not exceeding 100 mg/m3 unless a stricter local standard applies, and coatings must comply with the VOC content limits of GB 38507-2020. Hazardous wastes such as zinc dross, paint sludge, waste solvent containers and spent filters must be classified under the National Hazardous Waste List, stored in sealed, labelled, leak-proof containers in an approved hazardous waste storage room for not more than one year, and transferred only through the electronic hazardous waste manifest system to a licensed disposal operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before production commences, the applicant must obtain fire protection design review and fire acceptance inspection from the local fire and rescue authority under the Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, including compliance with building fire separation, automatic fire alarm, sprinkler, emergency lighting, exit signage and fire extinguisher requirements. Where the construction project meets the local threshold, civil air defense clearance must be obtained from the civil defense office, and structural load inspection certificates must demonstrate that floors, mezzanines, racking and die-casting machine foundations can bear the intended static and dynamic loads. The company must also complete workplace safety and occupational disease prevention triple-simultaneous evaluation covering noise at or below 85 dB(A) without hearing protection, heat stress controls around furnaces and die-casting cells, containment of metal fume and zinc oxide particulates, emergency shower and eye-wash stations, hazardous chemical storage cabinets, and pre-employment and periodic occupational health examinations for exposed workers, before the local Emergency Management Bureau issues the work safety condition clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online electronic tax portal: the Electronic Taxpayer Service (e-Tax system) under the national integrated tax information system (Golden Tax Project Phase IV), accessed through the provincial tax authority for the WFOE's registered location and used for tax registration, monthly/quarterly filings, VAT invoice administration, payment, and export rebate applications.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE obtains its statutory taxpayer identifier automatically through the multi-license integration procedure: upon issuance of the business license by the State Administration for Market Regulation, the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) is issued and serves as the taxpayer identification number (TIN/VAT registration number). Within 30 days after the business license is issued, the WFOE must complete tax registration information through the Electronic Taxpayer Service or at the in-charge tax office, submitting incorporation documents, legal representative identity, registered address, business scope, capital structure, bank deposit account information, and expected tax-filing arrangements. For a foreign non-resident entity that is not incorporated in mainland China but derives Chinese-source income, the non-resident enterprise must apply for a non-resident tax identification code with the in-charge tax authority by filing the foreign certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, board resolution appointing a responsible person or Chinese tax agent, and the underlying contract or evidence of Chinese-source income; this registration enables proper withholding tax, VAT, and e-invoice compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC tax law provides no check-the-box entity classification election and no hybrid mismatch election. The WFOE is mandatorily classified as a resident enterprise under Article 2 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and is subject to entity-level taxation on worldwide income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for VAT registration: every WFOE must register for VAT. For general taxpayer status, the mandatory annual taxable sales threshold is RMB 5,000,000; if annual taxable turnover is below RMB 5,000,000 (or monthly taxable sales do not exceed RMB 100,000 for small-scale taxpayer exemption purposes), the entity may remain a small-scale taxpayer but has no legal right to avoid registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates VAT invoice issuance through the State Taxation Administration's unified VAT invoicing and anti-fraud tax-control system under Golden Tax Project Phase IV. Fully digitalized e-invoices are generated through the national e-invoice platform and submitted to the tax authority in real time; every invoice receives the SAT's anti-fraud digital validation marker, and invoice data is cleared through the taxpayer's e-tax account before delivery to the recipient. B2B export sales require issuance of a valid VAT special or ordinary invoice, and the taxpayer must synchronize invoice data, VAT return data, and export customs clearance data under the integrated e-tax system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A WFOE exporting die-cast scale automotive models is eligible for the zero VAT rate (0% output VAT) and applicable input VAT refund/export rebate on the statutory conditions that the goods are: (1) actually shipped out of the customs territory of the PRC and declared to China Customs under an export customs declaration in the WFOE's name (or through a licensed export agent); (2) sold to an overseas buyer under an export sales contract; (3) not designated as prohibited or restricted export goods; (4) paid by the overseas buyer through cross-border foreign exchange or approved cross-border RMB settlement routed through a designated bank; and (5) supported by commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping documents, and customs export records. Qualifying offshore digital services are not within this goods-based scope; for the die-cast collectibles business, only physical goods exports are zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (export clearance record from the General Administration of Customs) evidencing the date and value of goods departed from the PRC territory
Original Bill of Lading or Air Waybill issued by the carrier evidencing shipment to the foreign buyer's destination
Export sales contract, commercial invoice, and packing list matching the declared customs value

Foreign exchange receipt evidence from a designated bank under the SAFE goods trade monitoring system, showing repatriation of export proceeds from the offshore buyer in foreign currency or approved cross-border RMB
VAT invoice and export tax refund declaration (where an input VAT refund is claimed) together with export rebate supporting documents
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If an export zero-rating claim is found to be unsupported or fraudulent, the tax authority will deem the export sale taxable at 13% output VAT, withdraw any VAT refund or exemption already granted, recover the unpaid tax with a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day under Article 32 of the Tax Administration and Collection Law, and impose a penalty of 50% to 5 times the tax involved under Article 63 for fraudulent refund claims. Where customs exit records, export declarations, bills of lading, or foreign exchange repatriation evidence are falsified, the case may be referred for criminal prosecution under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law (fraudulent export tax rebate); the persons concerned may also be placed on the serious tax violation list and subjected to cross-border payment and exit restrictions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the foreign-exchange regulatory authority of the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains current-account convertibility for goods trade, meaning that genuine export and import settlements can be converted freely at licensed banks after document inspection. However, the capital account remains regulated: foreign direct investment into the WFOE requires prior SAFE/FDI registration, a declared registered capital amount, and a licensed bank capital account. RMB cannot be unconditionally converted for capital outflow; profit remittance to the Hong Kong parent is an income item requiring board declaration, audited financial statements, tax clearance, and bank submission of the remittance application. Export proceeds do not need to be forcibly surrendered, but must be repatriated to China through the SAFE settlement and verification system, and every RMB conversion must correspond to an underlying trade transaction. The practical effect is that the treasury can achieve high liquidity for trade flows but must maintain a strict documentary file for each cross-border payment. The Hong Kong offshore CNH market is separate and open, yet the Mainland WFOE cannot use offshore CNH balances or NDFs to evade SAFE monitoring; any hedging must be executed onshore with a qualified domestic bank and supported by real exposure. Profit remittance to the Hong Kong parent also requires evidence that the WFOE has no outstanding tax disputes, that all customs and SAFE filings are current, and that the board resolution approving the dividend matches the registered corporate governance documents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory timeline: Export proceeds must be repatriated and settled within 180 days from the date of export customs declaration or within the contractually agreed collection period, whichever is earlier; banks must receive the export collection declaration and match it with customs data under the SAFE joint electronic verification system. Mandatory conversion: There is no fixed mandatory surrender ratio since China moved to a settlement-account system; the WFOE may retain 100% of eligible foreign currency receipts in an approved export settlement account or convert them to RMB at prevailing market rates. Each conversion requires supporting customs declaration, commercial invoice, packing list, logistics documents, and matching buyer identity.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary corporate treasury use. An offshore EMI such as Wise, Payoneer, or Airwallex cannot open a local RMB account in China in the name of the WFOE without a licensed domestic bank sponsor. Chinese FX regulations require all cross-border goods-trade receipts and payments to go through SAFE-regulated banking channels or licensed cross-border payment institutions. PayPal is permitted only as an auxiliary sales collection layer for direct consumer orders, not as a substitute for the onshore bank settlement account; all PayPal proceeds must be settled to the licensed bank account and declared to SAFE under export monitoring. Therefore, the recommended architecture is a domestic Tier-1 bank as the sole treasury spine and PayPal as a merchant acquisition front end.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Yes. The statutory legal representative or a duly appointed local director with original passports must attend at least one in-branch interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted by most Chinese commercial banks for first-time corporate account opening; a notarized power of attorney can support the local manager for day-to-day operations but cannot fully replace the legal representative for UBO attestation and bank compliance declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership chain through the Hong Kong parent, nominee directorship, or trust structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a group structure chart showing Hong Kong parent and Mainland WFOE; Certificate of Incorporation, Business Registration Certificate, Annual Return, and Beneficial Ownership Register from Hong Kong; passport copies of all directors and shareholders; notarized board resolutions; source-of-wealth statements; if the parent is trust-owned, the trust deed and evidence of settlors and beneficiaries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds received from PayPal or aggregated marketplaces rather than directly from named end customers, creating potential layering or mule-account typology.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the PayPal Business account registration, merchant verification documents, platform settlement reports with transaction IDs, buyer due diligence records showing names and shipping destinations, customs export declarations, waybills and courier receipts, commercial invoices, and a reconciliation showing PayPal settlement settling into the licensed bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering or transfer-pricing risk in die-cast collectibles, where pricing is discretionary and can be manipulated.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a priced product catalogue, third-party valuation or auction comps for the 1:18 scale models, HS 9503 customs classification confirmation, import and export contracts, booking and payment history, independent price database references, and the WFOE's internal transfer-pricing policy for related-party transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payments or settlements routed through intermediary trading companies, especially counterparties domiciled in sanctioned or enhanced-screening jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete transaction flow worksheet, UBO declarations from all material counterparties, OFAC/EU/UN/PRC sanctions screening reports, bills of lading and commercial invoices showing consignee names matching contract parties, bank reference letters, and signed declaration confirming no sanctioned counterparty is in the supply chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong parent should remit USD or HKD via SWIFT to the SAFE-specified capital escrow account of the WFOE at a Tier-1 domestic bank. The remitter and beneficiary names must exactly match the FDI registration and the WFOE business license. The remittance instruction must include the SAFE FDI registration code, the purpose code for the foreign direct investment capital contribution, and the word 'capital injection' in the message. Upon receipt, the bank will perform a capital account transaction review, post funds to the capital account, and issue a receipt voucher. The WFOE must then instruct a Chinese certified public accountant to issue the capital verification report for the registered capital. Conversion of the capital funds into RMB for operating expenses must follow actual working capital needs and be accompanied by supporting documents such as purchase orders, lease agreements, payroll schedules, and utility invoices.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For direct supplier payments, use SWIFT MT103 with the SAFE goods-trade purpose code, supported by customs declarations, commercial invoices, packing lists, and transport documents. For bulk raw-material imports, issue an irrevocable commercial letter of credit through the onshore relationship bank, with the Hong Kong parent or supplier as beneficiary and the WFOE as applicant. For stable open-account buyers, use documentary collection on D/P or D/A terms through the bank clearing rail. PayPal should be used only as a retail or marketplace collection channel for direct consumer orders, and all PayPal balances must be swept periodically into the licensed bank account with the transaction history retained for SAFE export verification.

permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/USD FX forward contracts through a licensed domestic bank on the basis of verified trade documents
FX swaps between onshore RMB and USD/HKD for liquidity repositioning, subject to SAFE reporting and real commercial exposure
Cross-currency swaps for long-term onshore/offshore funding exposure where the underlying debt is registered with SAFE
Plain-vanilla FX options on RMB/USD purchased from a domestic bank with a genuine hedging need
Offshore CNH RMB forwards in Hong Kong for the HK parent; NDFs on onshore RMB are not permissible for the China WFOE because SAFE permits only deliverable onshore hedging

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the company's anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing escalating from HKD 870 (USD 111) to HKD 3,480 (USD 444) for a private company if filed after 42 days but within 3 months; further escalating to HKD 8,000 (USD 1,025) after 6 months, and possible prosecution and strike-off from the Register of Companies after continuous default (typically 9+ months), with restoration only by court order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business Registration Fee plus Levy (BRR renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department (IRD), Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal on or before the expiry date of the current Business Registration Certificate (normally the anniversary of commencement/registration date); annual fee payable each year regardless of turnover
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew within the prescribed period subjects the entity to a late fee of up to HKD 3,000 (USD 384) for each certificate, and the proprietor may be prosecuted; the Business Registration Certificate is not automatically renewed after default and the business may be struck off or penalized with a maximum fine of HKD 50,000 (USD 6,410) for continued non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer Return (Form BIR56A) and Employer's Return of Remuneration (Form BIR56B / individual IR56B forms)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 each calendar year for the preceding year of assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing of IR56B forms may trigger prosecution with fines up to HKD 10,000 (USD 1,280) under the Inland Revenue Ordinance; persistent default can lead to estimated assessments and additional penalty of up to 200% of the undercharged tax for false or deficient returns.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profits Tax Return (Form BIR51 / BIR52) and supporting audited accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a new company, issued within 18 months of incorporation with filing due typically 3 months thereafter; for existing companies, issued on the first working day of April (Franked returns if taxpayer representative engaged: normally November 15, or extended to December 15 / January 31 for paper/efiling); exact deadline stated on the return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Liability to a 5% escalating surcharge (up to 10% for continued default) and prosecution under the Inland Revenue Ordinance; failure to file with intent to evade tax carries maximum fine of HKD 50,000 (USD 6,410) plus three times the amount of tax undercharged.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) and filing of special resolutions / directors' changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Hong Kong Companies Registry (CR) via prescribed forms (e.g., NS2, ND2A/ND2B, NR1/NG1 in some cases)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM must be held at least once per calendar year; for financial year end after 23 June 2021, private companies may dispense with AGM by unanimous consent or written resolution; changes of directors/company secretary must be filed within 15 days after occurrence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing of director/secretary change forms imposes escalating late fees from HKD 170 (USD 22) up to a maximum late fee of HKD 1,700 (USD 218) if more than 14 days late; failure to hold AGM or file resolutions can result in default of company officers liable to a fine up to HKD 30,000 (USD 3,846) and daily default fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Assessment / Demerit of Dormant Status Application (Revocation of Dormancy)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department (IRD) and Companies Registry (CR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Where the WFOE is dormant, file annual return and statutory declarations within prescribed 42-day window; if conducting business after dormancy, notify IRD and CR promptly and resume normal tax filings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to notify cessation of dormancy triggers deemed active assessment with penalties under the Inland Revenue Ordinance; false dormancy declarations attract criminal liability with fines and potential imprisonment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Hong Kong companies incorporated under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) regardless of size, turnover or balance sheet total must prepare financial statements that comply with the applicable financial reporting framework and be audited by a certified public accountant licensed under the Professional Accountants Ordinance (Cap. 50), except for a private company that is dormant under section 5 of Cap. 622 and has not carried on business since incorporation or has ceased business and is not a 'non-dormant' entity; there are no turnover, asset or headcount exemption thresholds in Hong Kong law for a WFOE operating as a normal active company, unlike SME audit thresholds in some jurisdictions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS) as issued by the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants (HKICPA), which are aligned with IFRS; companies qualifying as 'small private companies' may apply the HKFRS for Private Entities (a Hong Kong SME standard) or the simpler Small and Medium-sized Entity Financial Reporting Standard (SME-FRS) if eligible; in rare cases where the company's parent reporting framework is IFRS, IFRS as adopted by the HKICPA may be used; statutory books must be kept in accordance with section 373 of Cap. 622.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Hong Kong does not maintain a standalone annual UBO confirmation filing for all private companies. However, under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), every company must maintain a Significant Controllers Register (SCR) with prescribed particulars (a register of significant controllers) at its registered office or a prescribed location, and must keep it updated within 7 days of any change in significant controller status; a significant controller is any individual or legal entity holding more than 25% of the company's shares or votes or exercising significant influence or control. Internal annual confirmation (e.g., board review) is strongly advised to verify that the SCR reflects all changes, although the legal obligation is continuous and event-driven. Shareholding transfers must be reported to the Hong Kong Companies Registry by way of filing the prescribed stock return (Form NSC1) and the allotment return (Form NSC2) where newly issued, within 1 month of the transfer or allotment; the Company Register of Members must be updated and the share certificates issued within 10 business days (or 2 months if title transfer).

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Potential reduced rates for High-New Technology Enterprises (15%), small and low-profit enterprises (effective 5%-10%), manufacturing R&D super-deduction (100% of qualified R&D expenses), and regional incentives; tax holidays may be available for certain encouraged industries.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (A Class) filed through the State Taxation Administration E-Tax Portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final annual return due by May 31 of the following year; quarterly prepayments due within 15 days after each quarter end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Chinese-source and worldwide revenue recognized under PRC GAAP. For a WFOE receiving payments from overseas affiliates, ensure that intercompany sales are priced at arm's length and supported by functional analysis. Unreported offshore-managed revenue will trigger transfer pricing adjustment and penalties.

Allocate costs consistent with the accounting standards. Where raw materials are sourced from a related party, the cost plus method or TNMM must be applied. Deductions require lawful invoices; payments to non-residents without WHT will be disallowed and penalized.

Management fees, royalties, interest, and service fees paid or payable to non-residents must satisfy the arm's length principle and must have corresponding withholding tax paid. Excessive or undocumented intercompany charges must be reversed in the tax adjustment schedule.

Reconcile the Chinese statutory books with the consolidated reporting group. State the accounting profit after applying PRC GAAP. Any adjustment for foreign tax or permanent establishment impacts must be separately reflected.

Enter all permanent and timing adjustments, including excess intercompany interest, royalty topping-up, transfer pricing adjustments, non-tax-deductible penalties, and preferential deductions such as R&D super-deduction. Attach contemporaneous TP documentation if required.

This is the final taxable base. If negative, losses can be carried forward up to 5 years (or 10 years for qualified high-tech or SME). Losses cannot be carried back. A non-resident parent may not use WFOE's losses against its own income.

Enter 25% as the standard rate, or 15% if the enterprise qualifies as a High-New Technology Enterprise or enjoys another preferential rate. Incorrectly claiming a preferential rate without approval triggers back-payment and penalties.

Computed as taxable income multiplied by the applicable rate. Cross-border tax credits for foreign taxes paid on overseas income are limited to the Chinese tax payable for that income; excess credit cannot carry back.

Include foreign income tax credits, qualified equity investment credits, and transitional incentives. Credit entitlements must be evidenced by overseas tax certificates and substantiated beneficial ownership for treaty relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final actual tax payable after prepayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct quarterly prepayments and potential overpayments. Any unpaid balance is due by May 31. For dividends remitted abroad, separate WHT on profit distribution is due at the time of distribution and must be reported using the withholding return, not this line.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: RMB 2,000 (standard) or RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious cases under Article 62 of the Tax Administration Law; late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax (Article 32); understatement or evasion penalty of 50% to 500% of the deficient tax (Article 63); failure to withhold: 50% to 300% penalty on the unwithheld amount (Article 69); criminal prosecution under Article 201 of the Criminal Law for evasion exceeding RMB 100,000 and 10% of tax due, with imprisonment up to 7 years for large amounts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (or 5% under the Mainland-Hong Kong DTA for a Hong Kong resident company holding at least 25% of the WFOE's equity)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim the 5% dividend treaty rate, the beneficial owner must be a Hong Kong resident company holding at least 25% of the capital. The shareholder must obtain a Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and a certificate of residence status from the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department before the dividend distribution. The WFOE must retain the TRC, a beneficial ownership self-declaration, and documentary evidence of the ownership chain. The reduced rate applies only where the Hong Kong shareholder is the actual beneficial owner, has substantive business activities in Hong Kong, and does not pass through an intermediary. If treaty relief is not claimed in advance, 10% is withheld, and a refund may be sought afterwards via the Chinese tax authority after providing the same documentation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: interest 10%, royalties 10%. Under the Mainland-Hong Kong DTA: interest 7%, royalties 7% (certain industrial, commercial or scientific equipment royalties may be reduced further). Application requires the same TRC and beneficial ownership evidence; the payer must withhold domestic rate at source and apply for treaty relief through the withholding agent.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File (Contemporaneous Transfer Pricing Documentation) is mandatory if any of the following related-party transaction thresholds are exceeded: tangible asset transfers RMB 200 million; intangible asset transfers RMB 100 million; financial asset transfers RMB 100 million; other related-party transactions RMB 40 million. Master File is required when the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 5.5 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not have a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code like offshore jurisdictions, but anti-avoidance rules under Articles 6 and 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law require that intercompany arrangements reflect genuine economic substance. The Core Income-Generating Activity (CIGA) doctrine is embedded in transfer pricing rules: profits must be allocated where significant people functions, assets, and risks are located. A WFOE receiving dividends or royalties without substantive activities may be disregarded or re-characterized, leading to adjustments, interest, and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating revenue by failing to record foreign-currency income from die-cast model sales through PayPal or wire transfers, or using fraudulent invoices to inflate costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Administration Law Article 63: recovery of evaded tax plus late-payment interest; penalty of 50% to 500% of evaded tax; Criminal Law Article 201: if evaded tax amount exceeds RMB 100,000 and constitutes more than 10% of payable tax, imprisonment up to 3 years or criminal detention; if amount is huge and over 30%, imprisonment 3-7 years plus fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order or conceal the evasion are deemed directly responsible. The corporate veil may be pierced under Company Law Article 20: directors and shareholders may be personally liable for company debts. Civil asset restitution, travel bans (blacklisting) under tax collection measures, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and remitting dividend to the Hong Kong parent without withholding the statutory 10% (or treaty 5%) dividend tax, or omitting interest/royalty WHT on intra-group payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Administration Law Article 69: the withholding agent is jointly liable to pay the unwithheld tax; penalty of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld amount. Criminal exposure for intentional non-collection under Article 203 (serious cases).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are held personally responsible for the decision to skip WHT; they may face personal tax liability, civil damages to the tax authority, blacklisting in cross-border customs and travel, and criminal liability if willful evasion is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Treaty Benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing royalties or dividends through a Hong Kong-incorporated company without substance in Hong Kong solely to obtain the reduced 5% or 7% treaty rate while the real economic activity and management remain in mainland China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 47 and Implementation Regulation Article 120: tax authority may re-characterize the arrangement, impose adjusted tax, and charge an interest premium of up to 3 percentage points over the central bank benchmark rate (Special Tax Adjustment Measure, SAT Announcement 2017). No 50% penalty but a 0.5% monthly interest; criminal referral if fraudulent intent is found.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the deeming rules, the Hong Kong company is a conduit, so the WFOE's Chinese tax liabilities may be imposed on the actual controllers. Directors may be subjected to civil asset clawback, personal travel bans, and criminal penalties for fraud under Article 201 of the Criminal Law if they knowingly execute sham structures.
